notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello! 

This time, we come with a few balance changes. Our discord community has been very active and we understand some cards haven't been having the impact we expected, especially Bau Bau. These changes might help them synergize a bit more!


Balance Notes:


(4) Bau Bau: 

[strike]Increases by 1800% the efficiency of Karaoke Bar and Concert Venue.[/strike]

For every 10 Artists, increase efficiency of each Space Colony asset by 150%.

(4) Fubuzilla: 

[strike]If Gamers, increases by a value of +2400 the efficiency of the collab below.[/strike]

If Gamers, multiplies by 240x the efficiency of the collab below.

(4) Bweh: 

Added the Bijou group to conditional effect.

(3) Inugami Korone: 

[strike]If Gamers or Korone, increases by a value of +900 the efficiency of the collab to the left.[/strike]

If Gamers or Korone, multiplies by 105x the efficiency of the collab to the top right.

(3) Cecillia Immergreen: 

[strike]If Justice or Equipment, increases by a value of +600 the efficiency of the collab to the left.[/strike]

If Justice, multiplies by 90x the efficiency of the collab to the left.

(1) Magnifying Glass: 

Added the Myth group to it.

(1) Thorn: 

Added the Justice group to it.

(1) Umbrella: 

Added the Kobo and HoloID groups to it.

(1) Plug Type Asacoco: 

Added the Talent group to it.

(1) Subarudo: 

Added the Talent group to it.


QoL Improvements:


You can now enable Number Formatting for Collabs in the Settings Menu.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627083/3d89151c00a7c64dcd2d3f548e90b77b08590930.png"]
Bug Fixes:
Fixed a bug where you could delete your HoloSim by changing the bed.

Removed legacy library.

Fixed a bug where your next Encore Threshold might not appear correctly.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 + What's Next?
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! The last day was a roller-coaster of emotions, and we saw the birth of a beautiful community that banded together and gave us a lot of insight about the future of Holoidle!



We want to first start with the patch notes for 1.1.0! We are smoothing out the Encore curve. We still want the idle part of our idle game, but we also feel like Encore could be happening a little more frequently at lower encores. This will also allow us more predictability for future updates (more on that later), and a less reliance on good collabs. We also bring in a few QOL changes that should help keep track of your stream!


Patch Notes:
Smoothed out the Encore Curve, meaning you will reach Encore much faster!

Set IpS Bonus gained when you Encore to a curve instead of a fixed 100% value.

You can no longer gain duplicates of Foil cards when you still have cards to unlock.

Added the capability to click a Trash to clean it. You can still sweep it clean if you want.

Added a Encore threshold indicator when hovering your Stream Panel (bottom panel).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627083/c95627910d4a14d6e38c9abc8f5d0ae007f5c775.png"]

Increased Smol Nene card's value to intended values.

Added an arrow icon to Collab Cards.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627083/5b9f1fc646850a820e32cfd06f49e93d504ea4be.png"]

Created a screen effect to showcase your chat insatisfaction when you aren't in the correct Activity.


What's Next:

We hear all the feedback, and we are working on a new system to let you reach even greater heights and increase decision-making! This system also utilizes duplicates, so your dupes will be worth a lot.

While we did smooth out the Encore curve, there is still a limit to how far you can get. This new system is supposed to increase your influence gathering power as well!

This will still take some time to develop and test, but be sure we are working hard at it. Holoidle is a passion project that is very dear to us, so we want to give you the best experience possible!

notes.title: Hotfix - v.1.0.6R
notes.content:
Day one and we already got some bug fixes! Thanks to the amazing work done by the community by reporting bugs in our Discord and on Twitter/X, we were able to solve a bunch of issues!!


Bug Fixes:


Fixed a major issue where 4 cards: Bazo, Smol Baelz, Cecilia Immergreen and Spelling Bee were unobtainable.

All kitchen appliances are now Buildable, as intended, so you can now use your hard earned furniture.

Fixed a mistake with the Card Enthusiast, Card Collector and Card Specialist achievements where it would count all owned cards, including duplicates, resulting in getting the achievement earlier than expected.

Fixed an issue where you couldn't change your selected Idol if it was your first time opening the game.

Added fail-safes to try and prevent loading corrupted/broken save files.

Fixed a bug where opening the cookbook and leaving it open would prevent clicking anywhere else in other tabs.

Fixed a bug with Smol Pekora's collab card, where the bonus should be ADD instead of MULTIPLY.

Fixed a bug with Sukonbu's collab card, where it would affect THEME PARK unintentionally.

Changed Sweeping logic, which should make cleaning trashes more reliable.
